title: CubeOS — self-hosted OS for Raspberry Pi, ARM64 SBCs, and x86/amd64
youtrack_disambiguator: project: CUBEOS — see roadmap §4 'The Four Tracks' for Track A/B/C/D scoping
spec_home_note: This repo (docs/, project 16) is the canonical spec home for the CubeOS project as a whole. Component-level repos (api project 13, dashboard project 14, hal project 22, coreapps project 19, releases project 20) may add their own component-scoped PROJECT.json that references this as parent_project.

component_repos.purpose: Packer image builder + Pi Imager manifest

parallel_dev_exception.workflow: merge/<feature_id> short-lived branch + 1 MR per feature + auto-delete branch on merge; per-component-repo dispatch (planner-decompose fans out a docs/spec to component-repo child specs)
parallel_dev_exception.rationale: CubeOS spans multiple repos. Worker contracts are single-repo, so cross-cutting features in docs/ must be decomposed into per-component child specs before worker dispatch.

security_posture: edge-deployed; minimal attack surface; SSH hardening + fail2ban + watchdog at OS level + X-HAL-Key ACL on HAL endpoints
_surfaces_note: http_api=true because docs/architecture/07_API_CONTRACTS.md defines the API contract (referenced by api/ component repo). persistent_data=true because docs/architecture/03_DATABASE_SCHEMA.md defines the schema. events=false because CubeOS uses synchronous orchestration (FlowEngine sagas), not event-bus.
